summary: A four-bar A-minor lofi chamber loop at 86 BPM. Piano states each bar's triad at the downbeat over bass roots A, F, C, G, with restrained kick/snare and exactly 32 quiet eighth-note hats. The flute introduces a short A–C–E motif, answers it with a varied phrase ending before beat 16, while cello and harp add sparse harmonic color. It ends on G and loops back to Am without a final tonic cadence.
